hints.text: The whole number has no decimal digits showing, but you can give it some. That makes the subtraction line up.
Write $5$ as $5.00$. Then count up from $2.36$: first to the next whole number $3$, and then from $3$ on to $5$.
It takes $0.64$ to reach $3$ and $2$ more to reach $5$, so $5 - 2.36 = 2.64$.

explanation: Write $5$ as $5.00$ so it has the same decimal places as $2.36$.
Count up from $2.36$ to find the difference: $2.36 + 0.64 = 3.00$, and then $3.00 + 2.00 = 5.00$.
